Linear's GraphQL API:
- `issues(filter: {search: {eq: "..."}, ...}, first: 10)` returns issues with `id`, `title`, etc.
- Subtasks are child issues. In Linear, subtasks have a `parent` field. I can query issues with `filter: {parent: {id: {eq: "..."}}}`.

```graphql
query {
  issues(filter: {search: {eq: "Q3 website refresh"}}, first: 10) {

}

}
```
